_readme: Cross-language vectors for places/locus_recipe.py and whg/webpack/js/locus_recipe.js. Generated by the Python module; both implementations must reproduce every field exactly. Regenerated 2026-10-21 in place at v1 when the stoplist left the recipe (place#325 ruling 3; no locus had been minted). Any later spec change must change the recipe version with it.

valid.name: atlas_default
valid.note: A typical Atlas soft cluster: viewport bounds, temporal window, shipped params, four members.

valid.name: atlas_default_reordered_noisy
valid.note: Semantically the same as atlas_default: must give the identical canonical, pid and token.

valid.name: spatial_sweep_no_query
valid.note: No query: a sweep by containment. Lists de-duplicated and sorted; ccodes upper, namespaces lower.

valid.name: unicode_and_sorting
valid.note: NFD input is NFC in the canonical form; `types` sorted by code point (U+FFFC before U+10300, which UTF-16 unit order would reverse) and de-duplicated; the local part of wd:q64x is case-preserved, so it is not wd:Q64x.

valid.name: number_ties_and_rounding
valid.note: Half-up on the shortest decimal repr: 0.12345 -> 0.1235, 1.0000005 -> 1.000001, 0.00004 -> 0, 0.99995 -> 1; integral values print without .0; -0 prints as 0.

valid.name: multipolygon_and_collection
valid.note: GeometryCollection members are de-duplicated and sorted by their canonical JSON.
